metadata.Name: FIJO
metadata.Description: A French Insurance Soft Skill Detection Dataset
metadata.Paper Title: FIJO: a French Insurance Soft Skill Detection Dataset
metadata.Abstract: Understanding the evolution of job requirements is becoming more important for workers, companies and public organizations to follow the fast transformation of the employment market. This article proposes a new public dataset, FIJO, containing insurance job offers, including many soft skill annotations. The dataset consists of non-annotated and annotated French job ads published by four Canadian insurance companies, as well as their metadata. The dataset statistics and characteristics show limitations that could have made it challenging to perform the learning task well.
